signature_info.description: Pass-through HID to KMDF Filter Driver

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed sample is a standard Windows kernel-mode HID (Human Interface Device) minidriver. It implements the expected boilerplate for a WDM/KMDF driver, including DriverEntry initialization, registration of IRP dispatch routines (PassThrough, Pnp, Power), and an AddDevice routine. It utilizes legitimate kernel APIs such as HidRegisterMinidriver and IoForwardIrpSynchronously. There are no signs of malicious behavior, unauthorized hooking, or obfuscation.
